title: Lost-in-the-Middle in Long-Text Generation: Synthetic Dataset, Evaluation Framework, and Mitigation
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical challenges of long-text generation, specifically addressing the 'lost-in-the-middle' phenomenon. It proposes a benchmark (LONGINOUTBENCH) and a mitigation strategy (RAL-WRITER). Evaluation metrics include length, consistency, and linguistic quality, with no components dedicated to religious, moral, or ethical benchmarking.
